title: Chapter frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of books/<resource-id>/chapters/<NN>-<slug>.md. One file holds one section of a mirrored book.

id.description: Chapter id in the form <resource-id>/<slug>. It is assigned once and never changes.

resource.description: Id of the resource the chapter belongs to.

part.description: Name of the part of the book that holds the section.

order.description: Reading position within the book, starting at 1. It may change between editions while the id stays.

section_label.description: The label the source prints for the section, such as a section number.

revision.description: Full commit SHA of the pinned source.

path.description: Path of the source file inside the upstream repository.

pages.description: First and last page of the section, counted from 1 in the source file's own page index.

extraction_status.description: How far review has gone. Only a person who has read the chapter against the source sets human-reviewed.

errata.description: Known upstream errata. They are recorded here and never applied to the text.

slug.description: Kebab-case slug of lowercase letters and digits.

language.description: Language code such as en or zh.

version.description: Edition version made of letters, digits, and dots, such as v260615.
